acceptance_criteria.criterion: ErrorLogStore extends BaseStore with a SchemaVersion field.
append() creates entries with auto-incremented IDs and ISO 8601 timestamps.

list() returns entries in reverse chronological order (newest first).

getById() returns the entry or undefined for missing IDs.
clear() empties the entries array while preserving SchemaVersion.
